title: DeckZero
tagline: DeckZero: ENS-based ARG where NFT cards unlock identity, DAO power, and game lifestyle.
description:
DeckZero is an ENS-powered alternate reality game where your cards become your identity. Each card you collect is minted as an NFT on Flow and tied to your ENS name + in-game username, giving you a social identity that spans across DeckZero and the wider Web3 ecosystem.

Players complete challenges, AR quests, and events to earn cards. As they progress, they’re not just collecting NFTs—they’re building a verifiable, public record of their gaming lifestyle. Our cards can be integrated with existing tournaments like chess, football, or esports events, letting achievements in those arenas automatically extend into DeckZero.

The ultimate milestone: collect all 52 cards and you graduate into the DeckZero DAO, becoming a stakeholder who can shape the future of the game and community. Players don’t just play; they own a piece of the ecosystem.
how_its_made:
Unity + Photon: Core multiplayer game client, handles AR-based card challenges, location-based gameplay, and real-time sessions.

Next.js Fullstack: Middleware that syncs Unity events with blockchain logic. After matches, results and rewards flow here for minting and ENS integration.

Flow Blockchain: Cards minted as NFTs with real value and portability.

ENS (Ethereum Name Service): Every player links their ENS name, merging identity, card collection, and username into one unified layer. This identity persists across tournaments, partnerships, and games.

DAO layer: Once a player owns the full deck (52 cards), they unlock DAO membership, gaining governance rights and true stakeholding in the ecosystem.
